notes.title: New feature update
notes.content: New languages ​​have been added to the title screen and in-game menu monitor in English, Spanish, Chinese (simplified), Russian, and German! You can now expand your store!

notes.title: New feature update
notes.content: Thank you to everyone who has made a purchase! Finally, you can now make your own original burger! Place any toppings on the bottom bun to complete the burger. The delivery function will be added in an update later this month! Also, the cardboard that flew away has been fixed, and you can now hold it by aligning your viewpoint and clicking the T key! We have also added a volume setting, so if you were unable to adjust the volume and closed the game, please try setting the volume from the settings! You can check the recipe on the monitor on the right side of the kitchen!
